summary: Master performance management with our training designed for managers. Improve appraisal techniques and drive team success through effective feedback.
lede: Appraisal training for managers covers setting measurable objectives, reviewing performance evidence, and leading appraisal conversations. It is for managers and HR professionals who set expectations, coach employees, or support appraisal quality. Learners practise aligning team goals with priorities, applying rating criteria consistently, giving behaviour-based feedback, and turning review findings into development or improvement plans.
audienceIntro: This performance management course is designed for professionals who set expectations, review contribution, coach employees, or govern appraisal quality across teams. It suits intermediate to advanced learners who already manage people or support formal talent processes.
prerequisites: You should bring a current or representative role profile, objective-setting template, appraisal form, or performance policy where organizational confidentiality permits. You will work with supplied examples and datasets, so access to confidential employee records is not required. A laptop is recommended for the performance dashboard exercise. Advanced analytics and AI content remains at conceptual awareness and operational application level rather than technical engineering.
